desc: Compute gaps d[i] = X[i+1] - X[i] for i=0..N-2.
Separate even-indexed gaps (i%2==0) and odd-indexed gaps (i%2==1) into two lists.
Sort both lists in ascending order.
Reconstruct the gaps array by placing sorted even gaps back to even indices and sorted odd gaps back to odd indices.
Compute final sum: N*X[0] + Σ (N-1-i) * opt_gaps[i].
